invariants.positive_case: high or unknown-high-signal request produces a Full delivery snapshot
invariants.negative_case: a high-risk request accepts a Lite or Micro route preference

invariants.rule: execution route must-not grant capability forbidden by intent
invariants.negative_case: review or research intent launches a repository writer

invariants.rule: budget expiry must-not remove required Gate/review/confirmation
invariants.positive_case: budget expiry produces a terminal report with Gate requirements unchanged
invariants.negative_case: execution continues by skipping a required Gate or confirmation

invariants.rule: each route envelope must use only its conditional task/slice/packet/risk/confirmation fields and exact Gate allow-list
invariants.positive_case: Small, Micro and Lite omit Full-only fields and Gates while a Full writer binds its current selected packet
invariants.negative_case: a lower route inherits a Full Gate or a worker guesses a missing envelope id

invariants.rule: live budget counters must use the exact policy values and carry cumulative usage across retry/run/resume
invariants.positive_case: observed attempts, reads and repairs consume one immutable selection-generation budget
invariants.negative_case: a new run or provider resets usage or planned context bytes replace actual reads

invariants.rule: host_inline must remain advisory and managed enforcement must require the matching actively probed runner capability
invariants.positive_case: an unsupported counter is unknown or advisory, or the managed launch blocks
invariants.negative_case: a host, legacy path or local string is reported as hard enforced or trusted identity

invariants.rule: guarded wrapper must-not call official start unless all START_READY/risk/confirmation preconditions are current
invariants.positive_case: exact current tuple reaches one official call
invariants.negative_case: stale packet or attestation reaches official start

invariants.rule: guarded start must-not use pre-lock lifecycle snapshot without post-lock CAS and durable attempt
invariants.positive_case: status, pointer, context and digests are re-read and attempt is fsynced before official call
invariants.negative_case: a check/use race or missing durable attempt reaches official start

invariants.rule: wrapper compensation must restore every official surface it can prove, while direct official start must-not guess unknown pre-state
invariants.positive_case: wrapper status/pointer are restored by CAS and direct bypass remains advisory
invariants.negative_case: status-only rollback or an invented previous pointer is written

invariants.rule: official task lifecycle must-not own or fabricate Supervisor run state
invariants.positive_case: Supervisor alone creates run state after a verified guarded result
invariants.negative_case: wrapper, hook or task.py writes previous/current run

invariants.rule: bootstrap exception must remain one exclusive hash-chained task/digest/slice event and burn after wrapper verification
invariants.positive_case: exact prepared, consumed and burned chain binds current Gates, reviews, confirmation, contract, packet and postchecks for this task and delivery-control only
invariants.negative_case: a missing, corrupt or reused record, invented TTY ref, bypassed postcheck or official hard-enforcement claim is accepted
